decision.summary: v1 ships English-only. Telugu is deferred to v1.1 (PRD amendment A1).
decision.reason: The only content available is the consolidated English bank. The AP Telugu PDFs exist but aptransport.org is unreachable from the build environment. Machine translation is forbidden by the PRD.
decision.reversal: Add "te" to languages, supply Telugu content, and every gate re-arms automatically.
